resources.string: A new draft supports up to 20 distinct exercises. Create a program with the exercises you want to repeat.
Exercise favorites/notes: %1$s entries. These also replace the current exercise preferences.
Choose a source date and review the recorded portions. Confirm adds new entries to %1$s and keeps existing meals and source snapshots.
These share at least one primary muscle. Equipment and movement demands differ; choosing one does not change your plan.
Log repetitions per side. For a single-arm dumbbell movement, log the weight of that dumbbell.
No supporting muscles mapped in this simplified view
For these dumbbell variants, log one dumbbell’s kg. Keep your convention consistent; historical entries are not converted.
Barbell: total bar + plates. Machine/cable: displayed load. Bodyweight: added external load only. Keep equipment and units consistent.
Starts a new draft today with the exercise order and rest time. Completed sets, loads and sensor readings stay in history.
Exports completed workout sets in kg, including warm-ups and any workout names, to a readable CSV file. It is not encrypted. Choose a destination you trust; your encrypted backup is separate.
Enter your chosen total load, bar weight and available pairs. The result loads both sides equally using standard metric plates. This tool does not choose a training load.
Exact balanced load is unavailable with these pairs. Check the total and available plates.
